name: cmdb_customview_auth
label: Custom View Authorization Table
description: The custom view authorization table is used for configuring related queries for reporting scenarios such as association queries.

fields.name: customview_id
fields.description: View ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: auth_type
fields.description: 'User','team','role', used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: auth_uuid
fields.description: Auth UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the customview_id, auth_type, auth_uuid fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_auth_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the auth_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_customview_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the customview_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
